geo.title: Get started
geo.body:
Fold a right triangle along its altitude.

Goal: I can use the altitude to the hypotenuse to find similar triangles and geometric means.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Theorem: the altitude to the hypotenuse of a right triangle forms two triangles that are similar to the original triangle and to each other.

Each small triangle shares an acute angle with the big one and has a right angle, so AA applies. In right triangle ABC with right angle C and altitude CD, this gives the geometric mean relations: CD2 = AD times DB, AC2 = AD times AB and BC2 = DB times AB.

The geometric mean of a and b is √(ab).
